en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a studio portrait of four young women in traditional attire, seated and standing around a wooden bench. They wear patterned tops, wrapped skirts, bead jewelry, and hold long thin sticks or staffs. Below the photograph is a printed caption area with the photographer's credit and the title identifying them as 'Bondu Girls' from Sierra Leone. There is also a handwritten signature or note at the bottom.
